method: PIL ink-box geometry at a 390 px display width, plus Apple Vision OCR on the 390 px preview. Geometry is a proxy; physical-device review is still required.
ocr_note: Apple Vision accurate mode with language correction off. Cursive, faint or overlapping lines under-read, so recall is a lower bound on content legibility, not a publishability score.
readability_rule: Readable on a 390 px phone width when the smallest ink box is at least 8 px high; OCR recall is reported separately.
